notes: A letter of questions and the Imam's signed answers («التوقيع»): not a chain. The sayings are introduced by passive «روي لنا» and «وروي عن العالم عليه السلام» with the Imam only as «العالم», and no transmitter is named (rule 11: «روي عن الأئمة»)
The title «نسخة الدرج؛ مسائل محمد بن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري» names the letter's writer, but the signing Imam is not named, so no route is read (rule 5 needs the one asked)
